title: Represent relation function vectors with shared pretrained SAE atoms
hypothesis: On four held-out relation tasks in pinned Pythia-70m, selecting an SAE atom pool of 64 features from task IDs 0-11 and representing each task FV with eight signed sparse coefficients will preserve explicit-FV causal quality within .10 gold-logprob nats and .05 accuracy, use <=0.50x the explicit-FV incremental payload, and beat both native SAE top-8 activation and global-dictionary OMP-8 by >=.10 nats in both dev seeds.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70m plus pretrained tied SAE dictionary with 2048 atoms over the layer-3 residual stream (512 dimensions).
mirror_coordinate: A shared 64-feature atom pool selected from fit-task SAE activations plus eight signed coefficients/indices per function.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen support-derived relation function interventions represented over shared SAE atoms; task IDs 12-15 are held out from pool selection.

task.type: pretrained causal-LM relation recall with residual-stream interventions
task.sae_shape: tied encoder [2048,512] with 2048 encoder biases; decoder atoms are encoder rows
task.hook: MA-516 layer output 4 / GPT-NeoX layer 3 output
task.data_and_fv_extraction: Frozen MA-516 tasks, support/evaluation splits, and layer-4 function-vector extraction.
task.primary_metric: mean held-out gold candidate log probability on tasks 12-15

mirror_method.pool_selection: For each of the 12 fit-task teacher FVs, compute ReLU(v @ W.T + bias); sum activations over fit tasks; select the 64 largest aggregate-activation feature IDs. Held-out teacher FVs never select pool atoms.
mirror_method.encoding: For each task teacher vector, run eight-step signed matching pursuit over the selected 64 normalized SAE decoder atoms. Store eight within-pool uint8 IDs and eight FP32 coefficients.
mirror_method.decoding: Sum the eight chosen coefficients times their selected original SAE decoder atoms. No reconstructed vector is cached.

controls: Native SAE encoder activations: top eight positive feature activations and tied decoder reconstruction
Global-dictionary signed matching pursuit with eight atoms over all 2048 SAE features
Mirror shared-pool 64-atom signed matching pursuit with eight atoms

development.selection: No task, layer, pool-size, sparse-budget or scale tuning; fixed 64 pool atoms and 8 coefficients.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if both dev seeds preserve explicit-FV causal quality, meet the incremental byte cap, and beat both native SAE top-eight and global OMP by the frozen margin.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: per-task coefficient indices and FP32 values
native SAE activation feature indices and values
the full pretrained SAE artifact when computing standalone deployment bytes
storage.common_base: Report both incremental codes on top of a preloaded SAE system and standalone Pythia+SAE+code deployment bytes. Compare standalone total against Pythia+explicit-FV total; the SAE is not free in the standalone system.
storage.reconstruction: No per-task reconstructed residual vector is stored or cached.

compute.hardware: CPU, fixed five-thread limit, no GPU
compute.active_compute_proxy: report SAE encoding operations for pool selection, eight-step pursuit dot products/subtractions, sparse decode multiplies, residual adds, and transformer candidate sequences
compute.wall_clock: separate FV extraction, SAE pool selection/coding, and held-out query evaluation

gates.PASS: In both dev seeds, shared-pool reconstruction is within .05 accuracy and .10 mean gold-logprob nats of explicit FVs; incremental code payload <=0.50x explicit-FV bank bytes; and causal gold-logprob exceeds both native top-8 SAE and global OMP-8 by >=.10 nats.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen causal-quality, incremental-byte, or native-control attribution gate is missed. Report standalone SAE+code total even if incremental code is small.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: External SAE/model hash, task split, or deterministic replay fails.

boundaries: A single pretrained 4x SAE on one 70M model and four held-out constrained relation tasks; not a broad SAE steering benchmark.
SAE dictionary bytes are charged in standalone deployment and shared only in the incremental SAE-system comparison.
SAE sparse coding is an ordinary native baseline; a matching sparse representation is not Mirror-specific evidence.
Fresh seeds remain unopened unless all frozen gates pass.
